user.title: TSUN micro-inverter
user.description: Solarman logger of the inverter (LSW), read locally on TCP port 8899. Read-only: nothing is ever written to the inverter.

data.name: Name
data.skip_check: Add even if the inverter does not answer (night, logger off)

data_description.logger_sn: 10-digit 'Device serial number' on the logger's label or web page (not the inverter serial number).

error.invalid_sn: Invalid logger serial number (6 to 10 digits)
error.wrong_sn: The logger answered with another serial number: check the number on its label (not the inverter one).
error.cannot_connect: Logger unreachable on port 8899. At night the logger built into the inverter is off: tick the last box to add it anyway.
error.inverter_silent: The logger answers but the inverter is asleep (night). Tick the last box to add it anyway.

data_description.temp_offset: Value subtracted from the raw temperature register (40 per TSUN documentation).
data_description.comm_alert_delay: Alert when the inverter stays unreachable this long while it was producing (night standby is ignored).

data_description.underperf_mode: Adaptive: learned automatically. Each evening, each panel must have reached its usual best share of production at least once during the day; recurring and seasonal shadows are therefore never reported (alerts after 5 sunny days of learning). Simple: each panel is compared in real time with the average of the others.
data_description.underperf_threshold: Real-time check: a panel is underperforming when it produces this much less than expected: its usual production at that time (adaptive mode, Flow cards only, no notification) or the average of the others (simple mode, with notification).
data_description.underperf_delay: The gap must last this long before the Flow is triggered (filters passing shadows).
data_description.underperf_min_power: No check below this average panel power (dawn, dusk, heavy clouds).
data_description.daily_threshold: Adaptive mode: a panel whose best share of the day is this much below its usual best share is reported in the evening (dirt, cable, diode, ageing). Minimum value: it widens by itself for a naturally irregular panel.

data_description.voltage_max: Above this value a warning is logged (EN 50160: 253 V). Overvoltage makes inverters disconnect.

data_description.forecast_enabled: Hourly weather forecast of the sunlight on your panels (Open-Meteo, free, no account), calibrated automatically on what your installation actually produces. The Homey location, rounded to about 1 km, is sent to api.open-meteo.com once an hour.
data_description.forecast_tilt: 0° = flat, 90° = vertical. A typical tiled roof is 25-35°.
data_description.forecast_azimuth: Compass bearing the panels face: 90 = east, 135 = south-east, 180 = south, 225 = south-west, 270 = west. Changing the tilt, orientation or peak power restarts the calibration.
data_description.forecast_peak: Total of the panels (e.g. 6 × 425 Wp = 2550). 0 = use the inverter rated power. Only sets the starting point: the calibration corrects it after a few sunny days.
data_description.forecast_model: Best match: Open-Meteo picks the best models for your location. Météo-France (AROME/ARPEGE) is the most precise in France.

data_description.notify_service: Optional, e.g. notify.mobile_app_iphone. A persistent notification is always created.

forecast_window.name: Forecast energy in a time window
forecast_window.description: Forecast production (kWh) of today or tomorrow between two local times. Fails when the forecast is off or not downloaded yet.

reset_baseline.name: Reset the learned panel profile
reset_baseline.description: Forgets the learned production profile of the panels; relearned in a few sunny days.
